name: Zhengde Emperor
contribution: The 11th emperor of the Ming dynasty of China, reigning from 1505 to 1521.

checks.lead: The Zhengde Emperor (14 November 1491 – 20 April 1521), personal name Zhu Houzhao, was the 11th emperor of the Ming dynasty of China, reigning from 1505 to 1521. He succeeded his father, the Hongzhi Emperor.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
